meaning: Hidden software that secretly watches what you do on a device. It sends what it learns to someone else.
clues: It tries to stay hidden, so you never know it is there.
It secretly records what you do on your device.
It may collect what you type, the sites you visit, or your passwords.
It has seven letters and starts with S. Think of a secret agent.
assumes: Ransomware locks your files and demands payment
Antivirus software scans for harmful programs

decoys.meaning: Harmful software that locks your files. The crook then demands payment to unlock them.
Software that scans a device for harmful programs and removes them.
A way to open a phone by looking at it. The phone checks that your face matches the one it saved.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: When I was new, the only thing watching my screen was a very curious cat.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Spyware often sneaks in with a free download. Get apps only from your phone's official app store, and skip files from strangers.

sources.name: FTC, Malware: How To Protect Against, Detect, and Remove It

blank.sentence: Hidden software on her laptop secretly watched what she did and sent it to someone else. It was ___.

why: It secretly watches what you do and sends it to someone else.
short: Hidden software that secretly watches you
